display_long_description:
Summary
Solve mazes like never before in VR! Hako Meiro VR is a unique puzzle game where the maze is drawn on the surface of a 3D object. Your goal is simple: trace the path and reach the finish line. But there’s a twist—since it’s a solid object, you can’t see the whole path at once!

How to Play
Rotate and Explore: Grab and rotate the box to see it from every angle. Hidden paths are waiting to be discovered on the back and sides.

Trace the Path: Carefully navigate the 3D surface to find your way to the goal.

Unlock the Surprise: Once you reach the goal, watch as a special CG model pops out from inside the box!

Key Features
Spatial Puzzle Experience: Enhances your spatial awareness as you manipulate objects in 3D space.

Intuitive Controls: Designed for VR—simply grab, rotate, and trace.

Satisfying Rewards: A fun variety of CG surprises await you at the end of every maze.

Can you find the path to the goal? Spin the box and start the challenge today!
